name: CHEG 4144
title: In Silico Chemical Engineering Senior Laboratory
description: Various computation tools and software used to approximate the solution of chemical engineering problems focusing on reaction kinetics, reactor design, process control, fluid, and mass transfer; for data analysis and visualization; emphasis on student teamwork and on use of computational tools and software to meet the course objectives.
requirement_description: CHEG 3112, 3220, 3240; open only to Chemical Engineering majors.
